ko.title: 이자 청구서가 돌아오다: 10년 만기 국채 수익률 5.3%가 워싱턴 예산에 의미하는 것

segments.src: When the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbed to about 5.3%, it reached a level not seen in more than two decades.
segments.tr: 벤치마크 10년 만기 국채 수익률이 약 5.3%까지 상승했을 때, 이는 20년 넘게 볼 수 없었던 수준에 도달했습니다.

segments.src: For most people, a bond yield is an abstract number on a financial news ticker.
segments.tr: 대부분의 사람들에게 채권 수익률은 금융 뉴스 티커에 나오는 추상적인 숫자에 불과합니다.

segments.src: For the federal government, it is something closer to an interest rate on a very large credit line, and it determines how much taxpayers must pay each year just to carry the national debt.
segments.tr: 연방 정부에게 그것은 매우 큰 신용 한도에 대한 이자율과 더 가까운 것이며, 납세자들이 국가 부채를 유지하기 위해 매년 얼마나 지불해야 하는지를 결정합니다.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how Treasury yields translate into federal interest costs, why those costs matter, and how they compete with other priorities in the federal budget.
segments.tr: 이 설명 자료는 국채 수익률이 어떻게 연방 이자 비용으로 전환되는지, 왜 그러한 비용이 중요한지, 그리고 연방 예산에서 다른 우선순위와 어떻게 경쟁하는지를 살펴봅니다.

segments.src: Figures below are rounded and illustrative; check the Treasury Department, the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for the latest official numbers.
segments.tr: 아래 수치는 반올림된 예시이며, 최신 공식 수치는 재무부, 의회예산국(CBO) 및 관리예산처(OMB)를 확인하십시오.

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters
segments.tr: ## 10년 만기 수익률이 중요한 이유

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is one of the most closely watched interest rates in the world.
segments.tr: 10년 만기 국채는 세계에서 가장 면밀히 관찰되는 금리 중 하나입니다.

segments.src: It reflects what investors demand to lend money to the U.S.
segments.tr: 이는 투자자들이 미국 정부에 10년 동안 돈을 빌려주기 위해 요구하는 것을 반영합니다.

segments.src: government for a decade.
segments.tr: 정부에 10년 동안 돈을 빌려주기 위해 투자자들이 요구하는 수익률을 반영합니다.

segments.src: It also acts as a reference point for many other borrowing costs, including mortgage rates, corporate bonds and some business loans.
segments.tr: 또한 이는 주택 담보 대출 금리, 회사채 및 일부 기업 대출을 포함한 다른 많은 차입 비용의 기준점 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: A rising yield means the government must offer investors a higher return to attract buyers at auction.
segments.tr: 수익률 상승은 정부가 경매에서 구매자를 유치하기 위해 투자자들에게 더 높은 수익을 제공해야 함을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Yields move for several reasons:
segments.tr: 수익률은 여러 가지 이유로 변동합니다:

segments.src: - **Expectations for inflation:** If investors expect prices to keep rising, they ask for a higher yield to protect purchasing power.
segments.tr: - **인플레이션 기대:** 투자자들이 물가가 계속 오를 것으로 예상하면 구매력을 보호하기 위해 더 높은 수익률을 요구합니다.

segments.src: - **Central bank policy:** The Federal Reserve sets short-term rates directly and influences longer-term rates through its policy path and balance sheet.
segments.tr: - **중앙은행 정책:** 연방준비제도는 단기 금리를 직접 설정하고 정책 경로와 대차대조표를 통해 장기 금리에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Supply and demand:** Heavy federal borrowing increases the supply of Treasuries, which can push yields higher if demand does not keep pace.
segments.tr: - **수급:** 막대한 연방 차입은 국채 공급을 증가시키며, 수요가 이를 따라가지 못하면 수익률이 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Perceived risk and term premium:** Investors may require extra compensation for the uncertainty of lending over a long period.
segments.tr: - **인식된 위험 및 기간 프리미엄:** 투자자들은 장기간 대출에 따른 불확실성에 대해 추가 보상을 요구할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## From yield to interest bill
segments.tr: ## 수익률에서 이자 청구서까지

segments.src: The federal government does not borrow all at once at a single rate.
segments.tr: 연방 정부는 한 번에 단일 금리로 모든 돈을 빌리지 않습니다.

segments.src: It issues a mix of short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: 정부는 단기 재정증권, 중기 국채, 장기 국채를 혼합하여 발행합니다.

segments.src: Existing debt keeps paying the rate set when it was issued until it matures.
segments.tr: 기존 부채는 만기가 될 때까지 발행 당시 설정된 금리를 계속 지불합니다.

segments.src: Then the Treasury refinances it at whatever rates prevail at that time.
segments.tr: 그런 다음 재무부는 당시 지배적인 금리로 이를 차환합니다.

segments.src: This is why the cost of higher rates arrives gradually:
segments.tr: 이것이 금리 인상 비용이 점진적으로 발생하는 이유입니다:

segments.src: 1. **New borrowing** to cover current deficits is priced at today's yields.
segments.tr: 1. **신규 차입:** 현재 적자를 충당하기 위한 신규 차입은 오늘의 수익률로 가격이 책정됩니다.

segments.src: 2. **Maturing debt** that was issued when rates were very low must be rolled over at higher rates.
segments.tr: 2. **만기 도래 부채:** 금리가 매우 낮을 때 발행된 만기 도래 부채는 더 높은 금리로 차환되어야 합니다.

segments.src: 3. **Short-term bills** reprice quickly, so they pass higher rates into the budget almost immediately.
segments.tr: 3. **단기 재정증권:** 단기 재정증권은 빠르게 재평가되므로 더 높은 금리가 거의 즉시 예산에 반영됩니다.

segments.src: The result is that the *average* interest rate on all federal debt tends to lag behind market yields, then drift upward as older, cheaper debt is replaced.
segments.tr: 그 결과 모든 연방 부채에 대한 *평균* 이자율은 시장 수익률보다 뒤처지는 경향이 있으며, 오래되고 저렴한 부채가 교체됨에 따라 점차 상승합니다.

segments.src: Even if yields stopped rising today, the average cost of the debt could keep climbing for years.
segments.tr: 오늘 수익률 상승이 멈추더라도 부채의 평균 비용은 수년간 계속 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A simple way to see the scale
segments.tr: ## 규모를 파악하는 간단한 방법

segments.src: Total federal debt held by the public is measured in tens of trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: 대중이 보유한 총 연방 부채는 수십조 달러 단위로 측정됩니다.

segments.src: A small change in the average interest rate, applied to a base that large, adds up quickly.
segments.tr: 그렇게 큰 기반에 적용되는 평균 이자율의 작은 변화는 빠르게 누적됩니다.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, each additional percentage point on the average rate adds hundreds of billions of dollars in annual interest costs once it has fully worked through the debt portfolio.
segments.tr: 대략적인 경험 법칙으로, 평균 금리가 1%포인트 추가될 때마다 부채 포트폴리오에 완전히 반영되면 연간 수천억 달러의 이자 비용이 추가됩니다.

segments.src: In recent years, net interest has grown into one of the largest single items in the federal budget.
segments.tr: 최근 몇 년 동안 순이자는 연방 예산에서 가장 큰 단일 항목 중 하나로 성장했습니다.

segments.src: CBO projections have shown it surpassing major categories of spending that policymakers have long treated as fixed priorities.
segments.tr: CBO 전망에 따르면 이는 정책 입안자들이 오랫동안 고정된 우선순위로 취급해 온 주요 지출 범주를 넘어섰습니다.

segments.src: Net interest is also growing faster than most other parts of the budget, because it depends on both the size of the debt and the level of interest rates, and both have moved up.
segments.tr: 순이자는 또한 부채 규모와 이자율 수준 모두에 의존하며 둘 다 상승했기 때문에 예산의 다른 대부분 부분보다 빠르게 증가하고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How interest competes with other spending
segments.tr: ## 이자가 다른 지출과 경쟁하는 방식

segments.src: Interest is different from most budget items.
segments.tr: 이자는 대부분의 예산 항목과 다릅니다.

segments.src: It is not a program that Congress can fund at a chosen level each year.
segments.tr: 이는 의회가 매년 선택한 수준으로 자금을 지원할 수 있는 프로그램이 아닙니다.

segments.src: It is a legal obligation tied to Treasury securities that investors already hold.
segments.tr: 이는 투자자들이 이미 보유하고 있는 국채와 관련된 법적 의무입니다.

segments.src: That makes it a kind of first claim on federal revenue.
segments.tr: 그것은 연방 세입에 대한 일종의 우선 청구권이 됩니다.

segments.src: The federal budget generally falls into three broad groups:
segments.tr: 연방 예산은 일반적으로 세 가지 광범위한 그룹으로 나뉩니다:

segments.src: - **Mandatory spending**, such as Social Security and Medicare, which is set by existing law and eligibility rules.
segments.tr: - **의무 지출:** 사회보장 및 메디케어와 같이 기존 법률 및 자격 규칙에 의해 설정된 지출.

segments.src: - **Discretionary spending**, including defense, education, transportation, scientific research and many other programs that Congress funds through annual appropriations.
segments.tr: - **재량 지출:** 국방, 교육, 교통, 과학 연구 및 의회가 연간 세출을 통해 자금을 지원하는 기타 많은 프로그램을 포함.

segments.src: - **Net interest**, which is determined by the debt and prevailing interest rates.
segments.tr: - **순이자:** 부채와 일반적인 이자율에 의해 결정되는 지출.

segments.src: When net interest rises, it does not simply sit beside the other categories.
segments.tr: 순이자가 상승할 때, 그것은 단순히 다른 범주 옆에 머무르지 않습니다.

segments.src: Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for other purposes unless revenue increases or borrowing grows further.
segments.tr: 이자에 지출되는 모든 1달러는 세입이 증가하거나 차입이 더 늘어나지 않는 한 다른 목적에 사용할 수 없는 1달러입니다.

segments.src: That creates several pressures:
segments.tr: 이는 몇 가지 압력을 만듭니다:

segments.src: - **Defense:** Defense is the largest part of discretionary spending. Net interest costs that approach or exceed the defense budget can sharpen debates over military readiness, modernization and force size.
segments.tr: - **국방:** 국방은 재량 지출의 가장 큰 부분입니다. 국방 예산에 접근하거나 초과하는 순이자 비용은 군사 대비 태세, 현대화 및 병력 규모에 대한 논쟁을 심화시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Social Security and health programs:** These programs are already expected to grow as the population ages. Higher interest costs add to the total pressure on the budget at the same time.
segments.tr: - **사회보장 및 보건 프로그램:** 이 프로그램들은 인구 고령화에 따라 이미 성장할 것으로 예상됩니다. 더 높은 이자 비용은 동시에 예산에 대한 총 압력을 가중시킵니다.

segments.src: - **Other discretionary programs:** Areas such as infrastructure, research, education and public safety make up a smaller share of the budget and can feel the squeeze most when overall resources are tight.
segments.tr: - **기타 재량 프로그램:** 인프라, 연구, 교육 및 공공 안전과 같은 분야는 예산의 더 작은 부분을 차지하며 전반적인 자원이 부족할 때 가장 큰 압박을 느낄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Borrowing itself:** If the government borrows more to pay interest, the debt grows, which can lead to more interest in the following years. Analysts sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: - **차입 자체:** 정부가 이자를 지불하기 위해 더 많이 빌리면 부채가 증가하고, 이는 다음 해에 더 많은 이자로 이어질 수 있습니다. 분석가들은 때때로 이것을 복리 효과라고 설명합니다.

segments.src: ## What could change the picture
segments.tr: ## 상황을 바꿀 수 있는 것

segments.src: The outlook is not fixed.
segments.tr: 전망은 고정되어 있지 않습니다.

segments.src: Several factors could raise or lower future interest costs:
segments.tr: 여러 요인이 미래 이자 비용을 높이거나 낮출 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Interest rate path:** If inflation cools and the Federal Reserve lowers rates, yields could fall and ease pressure. If inflation proves stubborn, yields could stay elevated.
segments.tr: - **이자율 경로:** 인플레이션이 진정되고 연방준비제도가 금리를 낮추면 수익률이 하락하여 압력이 완화될 수 있습니다. 인플레이션이 완고하게 유지되면 수익률은 계속 높게 유지될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Economic growth:** Stronger growth increases tax revenue and can make a given level of debt easier to manage relative to the size of the economy.
segments.tr: - **경제 성장:** 더 강력한 성장은 세수를 증가시키며 경제 규모 대비 특정 수준의 부채를 관리하기 쉽게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Deficit decisions:** Changes in tax and spending policy affect how much new debt must be issued.
segments.tr: - **적자 결정:** 세금 및 지출 정책의 변화는 얼마나 많은 신규 부채를 발행해야 하는지에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Debt maturity choices:** The Treasury can adjust the mix of short- and long-term securities, which changes how quickly rate moves hit the budget.
segments.tr: - **부채 만기 선택:** 재무부는 단기 및 장기 증권의 혼합을 조정할 수 있으며, 이는 금리 변동이 예산에 얼마나 빨리 영향을 미치는지 변경합니다.

segments.src: - **Investor demand:** Appetite for Treasuries from domestic and foreign buyers affects the yields the government must pay.
segments.tr: - **투자자 수요:** 국내외 구매자들의 국채에 대한 수요는 정부가 지불해야 하는 수익률에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts disagree about how serious the risk is and what to do about it.
segments.tr: 경제학자와 예산 분석가들은 위험의 심각성과 대처 방법에 대해 의견이 다릅니다.

segments.src: Some stress the importance of gradual deficit reduction to stabilize debt.
segments.tr: 일부는 부채를 안정시키기 위해 점진적인 적자 감축의 중요성을 강조합니다.

segments.src: Others point out that growth, productivity and lower inflation can also improve the ratio of debt to the economy.
segments.tr: 다른 이들은 성장, 생산성 및 낮은 인플레이션이 경제 대비 부채 비율을 개선할 수 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Reasonable people weigh these tradeoffs differently, and the choices ultimately belong to voters and elected officials.
segments.tr: 합리적인 사람들은 이러한 상충 관계를 다르게 평가하며, 선택은 궁극적으로 유권자와 선출직 공무원에게 달려 있습니다.

segments.src: ## What it means for households
segments.tr: ## 가계에 미치는 의미

segments.src: A federal budget issue can feel distant, but higher Treasury yields reach households in practical ways:
segments.tr: 연방 예산 문제는 멀게 느껴질 수 있지만, 더 높은 국채 수익률은 실질적인 방식으로 가계에 영향을 미칩니다:

segments.src: - **Mortgage and loan rates** often move with long-term Treasury yields, affecting the cost of buying a home or financing a car.
segments.tr: - **주택 담보 및 대출 금리**는 종종 장기 국채 수익률과 함께 움직이며, 주택 구입이나 자동차 금융 비용에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Savings and money market accounts** may offer better returns when rates are higher.
segments.tr: - **저축 및 머니마켓 계좌**는 금리가 높을 때 더 나은 수익을 제공할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Retirement portfolios** can see changes in the value of bond holdings as yields shift.
segments.tr: - **은퇴 포트폴리오**는 수익률이 변함에 따라 채권 보유 가치의 변화를 볼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Public services** may face tighter funding if more tax revenue goes to interest.
segments.tr: - **공공 서비스**는 더 많은 세수가 이자로 지출되면 자금 조달이 더 어려워질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: A 10-year yield around 5.3% is a reminder that debt is not free.
segments.tr: 약 5.3%의 10년 만기 수익률은 부채가 공짜가 아니라는 것을 상기시켜 줍니다.

segments.src: The cost of borrowing is set by markets, and it flows directly into the federal budget as interest payments.
segments.tr: 차입 비용은 시장에 의해 결정되며, 이자 지급으로서 연방 예산으로 직접 흘러 들어갑니다.

segments.src: Because those payments are owed before discretionary choices are made, they shape what is left for defense, Social Security support, public investment and everything else.
segments.tr: 그러한 지급은 재량적 선택이 이루어지기 전에 빚진 것이기 때문에, 국방, 사회보장 지원, 공공 투자 및 기타 모든 것에 무엇이 남을지를 결정합니다.

zh.title: 利息账单到期：10年期美国国债收益率达到5.3%对华盛顿预算意味着什么

segments.src: When the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbed to about 5.3%, it reached a level not seen in more than two decades.
segments.tr: 当基准10年期美国国债收益率攀升至约5.3%时，它达到了二十多年来未曾见过的水平。

segments.src: For most people, a bond yield is an abstract number on a financial news ticker.
segments.tr: 对于大多数人来说，债券收益率只是金融新闻股票机上的一个抽象数字。

segments.src: For the federal government, it is something closer to an interest rate on a very large credit line, and it determines how much taxpayers must pay each year just to carry the national debt.
segments.tr: 对于联邦政府而言，它更像是极高信用额度的利率，并决定了纳税人每年必须支付多少资金来维持国债。

segments.src: This explainer walks through how Treasury yields translate into federal interest costs, why those costs matter, and how they compete with other priorities in the federal budget.
segments.tr: 本说明介绍了国债收益率如何转化为联邦利息成本、这些成本为何重要，以及它们如何与联邦预算中的其他优先事项竞争。

segments.src: Figures below are rounded and illustrative; check the Treasury Department, the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for the latest official numbers.
segments.tr: 以下数字经过四舍五入且仅具说明性质；请查阅财政部、国会预算办公室（CBO）和管理和预算办公室（OMB）以获取最新的官方数字。

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters
segments.tr: ## 为什么10年期收益率很重要

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is one of the most closely watched interest rates in the world.
segments.tr: 10年期美国国债是全球受到最密切关注的利率之一。

segments.src: It reflects what investors demand to lend money to the U.S.
segments.tr: 它反映了投资者向美国贷款所要求的回报。

segments.src: government for a decade.
segments.tr: 政府为期十年。

segments.src: It also acts as a reference point for many other borrowing costs, including mortgage rates, corporate bonds and some business loans.
segments.tr: 它还充当许多其他借贷成本的参考点，包括抵押贷款利率、公司债券和一些商业贷款。

segments.src: A rising yield means the government must offer investors a higher return to attract buyers at auction.
segments.tr: 收益率上升意味着政府必须向投资者提供更高的回报，以在拍卖中吸引买家。

segments.src: Yields move for several reasons:
segments.tr: 收益率因多种原因而变动：

segments.src: - **Expectations for inflation:** If investors expect prices to keep rising, they ask for a higher yield to protect purchasing power.
segments.tr: - **通货膨胀预期：**如果投资者预计物价将持续上涨，他们会要求更高的收益率以保护购买力。

segments.src: - **Central bank policy:** The Federal Reserve sets short-term rates directly and influences longer-term rates through its policy path and balance sheet.
segments.tr: - **中央银行政策：**美联储直接设定短期利率，并通过其政策路径和资产负债表影响长期利率。

segments.src: - **Supply and demand:** Heavy federal borrowing increases the supply of Treasuries, which can push yields higher if demand does not keep pace.
segments.tr: - **供求关系：**大量的联邦借贷增加了国债供应，如果需求跟不上，这可能会推高收益率。

segments.src: - **Perceived risk and term premium:** Investors may require extra compensation for the uncertainty of lending over a long period.
segments.tr: - **感知风险和期限溢价：**投资者可能需要额外的补偿来应对长期借贷的不确定性。

segments.src: ## From yield to interest bill
segments.tr: ## 从收益率到利息账单

segments.src: The federal government does not borrow all at once at a single rate.
segments.tr: 联邦政府并非一次性以单一利率借入所有资金。

segments.src: It issues a mix of short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: 它发行短期国库券、中期票据和长期债券的组合。

segments.src: Existing debt keeps paying the rate set when it was issued until it matures.
segments.tr: 现有债务在到期之前一直支付发行时设定的利率。

segments.src: Then the Treasury refinances it at whatever rates prevail at that time.
segments.tr: 然后财政部以当时的流行利率进行再融资。

segments.src: This is why the cost of higher rates arrives gradually:
segments.tr: 这就是为什么高利率的成本是逐渐到来的：

segments.src: 1. **New borrowing** to cover current deficits is priced at today's yields.
segments.tr: 1. **新借款**用于弥补当前的赤字，其定价按当今的收益率计算。

segments.src: 2. **Maturing debt** that was issued when rates were very low must be rolled over at higher rates.
segments.tr: **到期债务**是在利率非常低的时候发行的，必须以更高的利率展期。

segments.src: 3. **Short-term bills** reprice quickly, so they pass higher rates into the budget almost immediately.
segments.tr: 3. **短期国库券**重新定价迅速，因此它们几乎立即将更高的利率传递到预算中。

segments.src: The result is that the *average* interest rate on all federal debt tends to lag behind market yields, then drift upward as older, cheaper debt is replaced.
segments.tr: 结果是，所有联邦债务的*平均*利率往往落后于市场收益率，随着较旧、较便宜的债务被替换而向上漂移。

segments.src: Even if yields stopped rising today, the average cost of the debt could keep climbing for years.
segments.tr: 即使收益率今天停止上升，债务的平均成本也可能在数年内继续攀升。

segments.src: ## A simple way to see the scale
segments.tr: ## 了解规模的一种简单方法

segments.src: Total federal debt held by the public is measured in tens of trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: 公众持有的联邦债务总额达数万亿美元。

segments.src: A small change in the average interest rate, applied to a base that large, adds up quickly.
segments.tr: 平均利率的小幅变化，应用于如此大的基数上，很快就会累加起来。

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, each additional percentage point on the average rate adds hundreds of billions of dollars in annual interest costs once it has fully worked through the debt portfolio.
segments.tr: 作为经验法则，一旦平均利率完全落实到债务组合中，平均利率每增加一个百分点，每年就会增加数千亿美元的利息成本。

segments.src: In recent years, net interest has grown into one of the largest single items in the federal budget.
segments.tr: 近年来，净利息已成长为联邦预算中最大的单一项目之一。

segments.src: CBO projections have shown it surpassing major categories of spending that policymakers have long treated as fixed priorities.
segments.tr: CBO的预测显示，它已经超过了政策制定者长期视为固定优先事项的主要支出类别。

segments.src: Net interest is also growing faster than most other parts of the budget, because it depends on both the size of the debt and the level of interest rates, and both have moved up.
segments.tr: 净利息的增长速度也快于预算中的大多数其他部分，因为它既取决于债务规模，也取决于利率水平，而这两者都上升了。

segments.src: ## How interest competes with other spending
segments.tr: ## 利息如何与其他支出竞争

segments.src: Interest is different from most budget items.
segments.tr: 利息与大多数预算项目不同。

segments.src: It is not a program that Congress can fund at a chosen level each year.
segments.tr: 这不是国会每年可以按选定水平资助的项目。

segments.src: It is a legal obligation tied to Treasury securities that investors already hold.
segments.tr: 这是一项与投资者已持有的国债挂钩的法律义务。

segments.src: That makes it a kind of first claim on federal revenue.
segments.tr: 这使其成为对联邦收入的一种首要索取权。

segments.src: The federal budget generally falls into three broad groups:
segments.tr: 联邦预算通常分为三大类：

segments.src: - **Mandatory spending**, such as Social Security and Medicare, which is set by existing law and eligibility rules.
segments.tr: - **强制性支出**，例如社会保障和医疗保险，由现行法律和资格规则设定。

segments.src: - **Discretionary spending**, including defense, education, transportation, scientific research and many other programs that Congress funds through annual appropriations.
segments.tr: - **自由裁量支出**，包括国防、教育、交通、科学研究以及国会通过年度拨款资助的许多其他项目。

segments.src: - **Net interest**, which is determined by the debt and prevailing interest rates.
segments.tr: - **净利息**，由债务和流行利率决定。

segments.src: When net interest rises, it does not simply sit beside the other categories.
segments.tr: 当净利息上升时，它并不只是与其他类别并列。

segments.src: Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for other purposes unless revenue increases or borrowing grows further.
segments.tr: 除非增加收入或进一步增加借款，否则花在利息上的每一美元都是不能用于其他用途的一美元。

segments.src: That creates several pressures:
segments.tr: 这产生了多重压力：

segments.src: - **Defense:** Defense is the largest part of discretionary spending. Net interest costs that approach or exceed the defense budget can sharpen debates over military readiness, modernization and force size.
segments.tr: - **国防：**国防是自由裁量支出的最大部分。接近或超过国防预算的净利息成本可能会加剧关于军事战备、现代化和部队规模的辩论。

segments.src: - **Social Security and health programs:** These programs are already expected to grow as the population ages. Higher interest costs add to the total pressure on the budget at the same time.
segments.tr: - **社会保障和医疗项目：**随着人口老龄化，这些项目的增长预计将持续。更高的利息成本同时增加了对预算的总体压力。

segments.src: - **Other discretionary programs:** Areas such as infrastructure, research, education and public safety make up a smaller share of the budget and can feel the squeeze most when overall resources are tight.
segments.tr: - **其他自由裁量项目：**基础设施、研究、教育和公共安全等领域在预算中占比较小，当整体资源紧张时，它们受到的挤压最大。

segments.src: - **Borrowing itself:** If the government borrows more to pay interest, the debt grows, which can lead to more interest in the following years. Analysts sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: - **借款本身：**如果政府借更多的钱来支付利息，债务就会增加，这可能会导致接下来的几年产生更多利息。分析师有时将其描述为复利效应。

segments.src: ## What could change the picture
segments.tr: ## 什么可能会改变现状

segments.src: The outlook is not fixed.
segments.tr: 前景并非一成不变。

segments.src: Several factors could raise or lower future interest costs:
segments.tr: 几个因素可能会增加或减少未来的利息成本：

segments.src: - **Interest rate path:** If inflation cools and the Federal Reserve lowers rates, yields could fall and ease pressure. If inflation proves stubborn, yields could stay elevated.
segments.tr: - **利率路径：**如果通胀降温且美联储降息，收益率可能会下降并缓解压力。如果通胀居高不下，收益率可能会保持高位。

segments.src: - **Economic growth:** Stronger growth increases tax revenue and can make a given level of debt easier to manage relative to the size of the economy.
segments.tr: - **经济增长：**更强劲的增长会增加税收收入，并使特定水平的债务相对于经济规模更易于管理。

segments.src: - **Deficit decisions:** Changes in tax and spending policy affect how much new debt must be issued.
segments.tr: - **赤字决策：**税收和支出政策的变化会影响必须发行多少新债务。

segments.src: - **Debt maturity choices:** The Treasury can adjust the mix of short- and long-term securities, which changes how quickly rate moves hit the budget.
segments.tr: - **债务期限选择：**财政部可以调整短期和长期证券的组合，这会改变利率变动对预算产生影响的速度。

segments.src: - **Investor demand:** Appetite for Treasuries from domestic and foreign buyers affects the yields the government must pay.
segments.tr: - **投资者需求：**国内和外国买家对国债的胃口会影响政府必须支付的收益率。

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts disagree about how serious the risk is and what to do about it.
segments.tr: 经济学家和预算分析师对风险有多严重以及如何应对存在分歧。

segments.src: Some stress the importance of gradual deficit reduction to stabilize debt.
segments.tr: 一些人强调逐步减少赤字以稳定债务的重要性。

segments.src: Others point out that growth, productivity and lower inflation can also improve the ratio of debt to the economy.
segments.tr: 另一些人则指出，增长、生产力和较低的通胀也可以改善债务与经济的比率。

segments.src: Reasonable people weigh these tradeoffs differently, and the choices ultimately belong to voters and elected officials.
segments.tr: 理性的人对这些权衡有不同的权衡，选择最终属于选民和民选官员。

segments.src: ## What it means for households
segments.tr: ## 它对家庭意味着什么

segments.src: A federal budget issue can feel distant, but higher Treasury yields reach households in practical ways:
segments.tr: 联邦预算问题可能让人感觉遥远，但更高的国债收益率以实用方式触及家庭：

segments.src: - **Mortgage and loan rates** often move with long-term Treasury yields, affecting the cost of buying a home or financing a car.
segments.tr: - **抵押贷款和贷款利率**通常随长期国债收益率波动，影响购买房屋或融资汽车的成本。

segments.src: - **Savings and money market accounts** may offer better returns when rates are higher.
segments.tr: - **储蓄和货币市场账户**在利率较高时可能会提供更好的回报。

segments.src: - **Retirement portfolios** can see changes in the value of bond holdings as yields shift.
segments.tr: - **退休投资组合**随着收益率的变化，可以看到债券持仓价值的变化。

segments.src: - **Public services** may face tighter funding if more tax revenue goes to interest.
segments.tr: - **公共服务**如果更多的税收收入流向利息，可能会面临更紧缩的资金。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: A 10-year yield around 5.3% is a reminder that debt is not free.
segments.tr: 10年期收益率在5.3%左右提醒人们，债务不是免费的。

segments.src: The cost of borrowing is set by markets, and it flows directly into the federal budget as interest payments.
segments.tr: 借贷成本由市场设定，并作为利息支付直接流入联邦预算。

segments.src: Because those payments are owed before discretionary choices are made, they shape what is left for defense, Social Security support, public investment and everything else.
segments.tr: 由于这些付款是在做出自由裁量选择之前欠下的，它们决定了国防、社会保障支持、公共投资和其他一切剩余的内容。

segments.src: How Washington responds, through spending, revenue and growth policy, will determine how heavy that bill becomes.
segments.tr: 华盛顿如何通过支出、税收和增长政策做出回应，将决定该法案变得多么沉重。

segments.tr: यील्ड कई कारणों से बदलती हैं:

segments.src: - **Expectations for inflation:** If investors expect prices to keep rising, they ask for a higher yield to protect purchasing power.
segments.tr: - **मुद्रास्फीति की उम्मीदें:** यदि निवेशकों को उम्मीद है कि कीमतें बढ़ती रहेंगी, तो वे क्रय शक्ति की रक्षा के लिए उच्च यील्ड की मांग करते हैं।

segments.src: - **Central bank policy:** The Federal Reserve sets short-term rates directly and influences longer-term rates through its policy path and balance sheet.
segments.tr: - **केंद्रीय बैंक नीति:** फेडरल रिजर्व सीधे अल्पकालिक दरें निर्धारित करता है और अपने नीति पथ और बैलेंस शीट के माध्यम से लंबी अवधि की दरों को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: - **Supply and demand:** Heavy federal borrowing increases the supply of Treasuries, which can push yields higher if demand does not keep pace.
segments.tr: - **आपूर्ति और मांग:** भारी संघीय उधार से ट्रेजरी की आपूर्ति बढ़ती है, जो मांग मेल न खाने पर यील्ड को और बढ़ा सकती है।

segments.src: - **Perceived risk and term premium:** Investors may require extra compensation for the uncertainty of lending over a long period.
segments.tr: - **माना गया जोखिम और अवधि प्रीमियम:** निवेशकों को लंबी अवधि में उधार देने की अनिश्चितता के लिए अतिरिक्त मुआवजे की आवश्यकता हो सकती है।

segments.src: ## From yield to interest bill
segments.tr: ## यील्ड से ब्याज बिल तक

segments.src: The federal government does not borrow all at once at a single rate.
segments.tr: संघीय सरकार एक ही दर पर एक बार में सारा उधार नहीं लेती है।

segments.src: It issues a mix of short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: यह अल्पकालिक बिलों, मध्यम अवधि के नोटों और लंबी अवधि के बॉन्ड का मिश्रण जारी करती है।

segments.src: Existing debt keeps paying the rate set when it was issued until it matures.
segments.tr: मौजूदा ऋण तब तक जारी रहने वाली दर का भुगतान करता रहता है जब तक कि यह परिपक्व नहीं हो जाता।

segments.src: Then the Treasury refinances it at whatever rates prevail at that time.
segments.tr: फिर ट्रेजरी उस समय प्रचलित दरों पर इसे पुनर्वित्त करती है।

segments.src: This is why the cost of higher rates arrives gradually:
segments.tr: यही कारण है कि उच्च दरों की लागत धीरे-धीरे आती है:

segments.src: 1. **New borrowing** to cover current deficits is priced at today's yields.
segments.tr: 1. **नया उधार** वर्तमान घाटे को कवर करने के लिए आज की यील्ड पर मूल्यांकित किया जाता है।

segments.src: 2. **Maturing debt** that was issued when rates were very low must be rolled over at higher rates.
segments.tr: 2. **परिपक्व होने वाला ऋण** जो दरें बहुत कम होने पर जारी किया गया था, उसे उच्च दरों पर रोलओवर किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: 3. **Short-term bills** reprice quickly, so they pass higher rates into the budget almost immediately.
segments.tr: 3. **अल्पकालिक बिल** जल्दी से पुनर्मूल्यांकित होते हैं, इसलिए वे लगभग तुरंत बजट में उच्च दरों को पास करते हैं।

segments.src: The result is that the *average* interest rate on all federal debt tends to lag behind market yields, then drift upward as older, cheaper debt is replaced.
segments.tr: परिणाम यह है कि सभी संघीय ऋणों पर *औसत* ब्याज दर बाजार की यील्ड से पीछे रह जाती है, फिर पुराने, सस्ते ऋण के प्रतिस्थापित होने पर ऊपर की ओर बढ़ती है।

segments.src: Even if yields stopped rising today, the average cost of the debt could keep climbing for years.
segments.tr: भले ही यील्ड आज बढ़ना बंद हो जाए, लेकिन ऋण की औसत लागत वर्षों तक बढ़ती रह सकती है।

segments.src: ## A simple way to see the scale
segments.tr: ## पैमाने को देखने का एक सरल तरीका

segments.src: Total federal debt held by the public is measured in tens of trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: जनता के पास मौजूद कुल संघीय ऋण खरबों डॉलर में मापा जाता है।

segments.src: A small change in the average interest rate, applied to a base that large, adds up quickly.
segments.tr: औसत ब्याज दर में एक छोटा बदलाव, इतने बड़े आधार पर लागू होने पर, जल्दी से जुड़ जाता है।

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, each additional percentage point on the average rate adds hundreds of billions of dollars in annual interest costs once it has fully worked through the debt portfolio.
segments.tr: अंगूठे के एक मोटे नियम के रूप में, औसत दर पर प्रत्येक अतिरिक्त प्रतिशत बिंदु ऋण पोर्टफोलियो के माध्यम से पूरी तरह से काम करने के बाद वार्षिक ब्याज लागत में सैकड़ों अरब डॉलर जोड़ता है।

segments.src: In recent years, net interest has grown into one of the largest single items in the federal budget.
segments.tr: हाल के वर्षों में, शुद्ध ब्याज संघीय बजट में सबसे बड़ी एकल वस्तुओं में से एक बन गया है।

segments.src: CBO projections have shown it surpassing major categories of spending that policymakers have long treated as fixed priorities.
segments.tr: CBO अनुमानों से पता चला है कि यह खर्च की प्रमुख श्रेणियों को पार कर गया है जिन्हें नीति निर्माताओं ने लंबे समय से निश्चित प्राथमिकताओं के रूप में माना है।

segments.src: Net interest is also growing faster than most other parts of the budget, because it depends on both the size of the debt and the level of interest rates, and both have moved up.
segments.tr: शुद्ध ब्याज बजट के अधिकांश अन्य हिस्सों की तुलना में तेजी से बढ़ रहा है, क्योंकि यह ऋण के आकार और ब्याज दरों के स्तर दोनों पर निर्भर करता है, और दोनों ऊपर चले गए हैं।

segments.src: ## How interest competes with other spending
segments.tr: ## ब्याज अन्य खर्चों के साथ कैसे प्रतिस्पर्धा करता है

segments.src: Interest is different from most budget items.
segments.tr: ब्याज अधिकांश बजट मदों से अलग है।

segments.src: It is not a program that Congress can fund at a chosen level each year.
segments.tr: यह कोई ऐसा कार्यक्रम नहीं है जिसे कांग्रेस हर साल एक चुने हुए स्तर पर वित्त पोषित कर सके।

segments.src: It is a legal obligation tied to Treasury securities that investors already hold.
segments.tr: यह ट्रेजरी प्रतिभूतियों से जुड़ा एक कानूनी दायित्व है जो निवेशकों के पास पहले से मौजूद है।

segments.src: That makes it a kind of first claim on federal revenue.
segments.tr: यह इसे संघीय राजस्व पर एक प्रकार का पहला दावा बनाता है।

segments.src: The federal budget generally falls into three broad groups:
segments.tr: संघीय बजट आम तौर पर तीन व्यापक समूहों में आता है:

segments.src: - **Mandatory spending**, such as Social Security and Medicare, which is set by existing law and eligibility rules.
segments.tr: - **अनिवार्य खर्च**, जैसे सोशल सिक्योरिटी और मेडिकेयर, जो मौजूदा कानून और पात्रता नियमों द्वारा निर्धारित किया जाता है।

segments.src: - **Discretionary spending**, including defense, education, transportation, scientific research and many other programs that Congress funds through annual appropriations.
segments.tr: - **विवेकाधीन खर्च**, जिसमें रक्षा, शिक्षा, परिवहन, वैज्ञानिक अनुसंधान और कई अन्य कार्यक्रम शामिल हैं जिन्हें कांग्रेस वार्षिक Appropriations के माध्यम से वित्त पोषित करती है।

segments.src: - **Net interest**, which is determined by the debt and prevailing interest rates.
segments.tr: - **शुद्ध ब्याज**, जो ऋण और प्रचलित ब्याज दरों द्वारा निर्धारित किया जाता है।

segments.src: When net interest rises, it does not simply sit beside the other categories.
segments.tr: जब शुद्ध ब्याज बढ़ता है, तो यह अन्य श्रेणियों के साथ चुपचाप नहीं बैठता है।

segments.src: Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for other purposes unless revenue increases or borrowing grows further.
segments.tr: ब्याज पर खर्च किया गया प्रत्येक डॉलर अन्य उद्देश्यों के लिए उपलब्ध नहीं होने वाला डॉलर है जब तक कि राजस्व में वृद्धि न हो या उधार और न बढ़े।

segments.src: That creates several pressures:
segments.tr: यह कई दबाव पैदा करता है:

segments.src: - **Defense:** Defense is the largest part of discretionary spending. Net interest costs that approach or exceed the defense budget can sharpen debates over military readiness, modernization and force size.
segments.tr: - **रक्षा:** रक्षा विवेकाधीन खर्च का सबसे बड़ा हिस्सा है। शुद्ध ब्याज लागत जो रक्षा बजट के करीब पहुंचती है या उससे अधिक हो जाती है, वह सैन्य तैयारी, आधुनिकीकरण और बल के आकार पर बहस को तेज कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Social Security and health programs:** These programs are already expected to grow as the population ages. Higher interest costs add to the total pressure on the budget at the same time.
segments.tr: - **सोशल सिक्योरिटी और स्वास्थ्य कार्यक्रम:** आबादी के बूढ़े होने के साथ इन कार्यक्रमों के पहले से ही बढ़ने की उम्मीद है। उच्च ब्याज लागत उसी समय बजट पर कुल दबाव को बढ़ाती है।

segments.src: - **Other discretionary programs:** Areas such as infrastructure, research, education and public safety make up a smaller share of the budget and can feel the squeeze most when overall resources are tight.
segments.tr: - **अन्य विवेकाधीन कार्यक्रम:** बुनियादी ढांचा, अनुसंधान, शिक्षा और सार्वजनिक सुरक्षा जैसे क्षेत्र बजट का एक छोटा हिस्सा बनाते हैं और जब समग्र संसाधन तंग होते हैं तो सबसे अधिक दबाव महसूस कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Borrowing itself:** If the government borrows more to pay interest, the debt grows, which can lead to more interest in the following years. Analysts sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: - **उधार लेना ही:** यदि सरकार ब्याज का भुगतान करने के लिए अधिक उधार लेती है, तो ऋण बढ़ता है, जिससे आने वाले वर्षों में अधिक ब्याज हो सकता है। विश्लेषक कभी-कभी इसे एक मिश्रित प्रभाव के रूप में वर्णित करते हैं।

segments.src: ## What could change the picture
segments.tr: ## तस्वीर क्या बदल सकती है

segments.src: The outlook is not fixed.
segments.tr: दृष्टिकोण तय नहीं है।

segments.src: Several factors could raise or lower future interest costs:
segments.tr: कई कारक भविष्य की ब्याज लागत को बढ़ा या घटा सकते हैं:

segments.src: - **Interest rate path:** If inflation cools and the Federal Reserve lowers rates, yields could fall and ease pressure. If inflation proves stubborn, yields could stay elevated.
segments.tr: - **ब्याज दर पथ:** यदि मुद्रास्फीति ठंडी होती है और फेडरल रिजर्व दरें कम करता है, तो यील्ड गिर सकती है और दबाव कम हो सकता है। यदि मुद्रास्फीति जिद्दी साबित होती है, तो यील्ड ऊंची रह सकती है।

segments.src: - **Economic growth:** Stronger growth increases tax revenue and can make a given level of debt easier to manage relative to the size of the economy.
segments.tr: - **आर्थिक विकास:** मजबूत विकास कर राजस्व बढ़ाता है और अर्थव्यवस्था के आकार के सापेक्ष ऋण के दिए गए स्तर को प्रबंधित करना आसान बना सकता है।

segments.src: - **Deficit decisions:** Changes in tax and spending policy affect how much new debt must be issued.
segments.tr: - **घाटे के निर्णय:** कर और खर्च नीति में परिवर्तन इस बात को प्रभावित करते हैं कि कितना नया ऋण जारी किया जाना चाहिए।

segments.src: - **Debt maturity choices:** The Treasury can adjust the mix of short- and long-term securities, which changes how quickly rate moves hit the budget.
segments.tr: - **ऋण परिपक्वता विकल्प:** ट्रेजरी अल्प और दीर्घकालिक प्रतिभूतियों के मिश्रण को समायोजित कर सकती है, जो यह बदलती है कि दर में बदलाव कितनी जल्दी बजट को प्रभावित करता है।

segments.src: - **Investor demand:** Appetite for Treasuries from domestic and foreign buyers affects the yields the government must pay.
segments.tr: - **निवेशक की मांग:** घरेलू और विदेशी खरीदारों से ट्रेजरी की भूख उन यील्ड को प्रभावित करती है जिनका भुगतान सरकार को करना होगा।

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts disagree about how serious the risk is and what to do about it.
segments.tr: अर्थशास्त्री और बजट विश्लेषक इस बात से असहमत हैं कि जोखिम कितना गंभीर है और इसके बारे में क्या करना है।

segments.src: Some stress the importance of gradual deficit reduction to stabilize debt.
segments.tr: कुछ लोग ऋण को स्थिर करने के लिए क्रमिक घाटे में कमी के महत्व पर जोर देते हैं।

segments.src: Others point out that growth, productivity and lower inflation can also improve the ratio of debt to the economy.
segments.tr: अन्य लोग बताते हैं कि विकास, उत्पादकता और कम मुद्रास्फीति अर्थव्यवस्था के लिए ऋण के अनुपात में भी सुधार कर सकती है।

segments.src: Reasonable people weigh these tradeoffs differently, and the choices ultimately belong to voters and elected officials.
segments.tr: समझदार लोग इन ट्रेडऑफ़ को अलग तरह से तौलते हैं, और विकल्प अंततः मतदाताओं और चुने हुए अधिकारियों के हैं।

segments.src: ## What it means for households
segments.tr: ## यह परिवारों के लिए क्या मायने रखता है

segments.src: A federal budget issue can feel distant, but higher Treasury yields reach households in practical ways:
segments.tr: एक संघीय बजट मुद्दा दूर का महसूस हो सकता है, लेकिन उच्च ट्रेजरी यील्ड व्यावहारिक तरीकों से परिवारों तक पहुंचती है:

segments.src: - **Mortgage and loan rates** often move with long-term Treasury yields, affecting the cost of buying a home or financing a car.
segments.tr: - **मॉर्टगेज और ऋण दरें** अक्सर दीर्घकालिक ट्रेजरी यील्ड के साथ चलती हैं, जिससे घर खरीदने या कार वित्तपोषण की लागत प्रभावित होती है।

segments.src: - **Savings and money market accounts** may offer better returns when rates are higher.
segments.tr: - **बचत और मनी मार्केट खाते** दरें अधिक होने पर बेहतर रिटर्न दे सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Retirement portfolios** can see changes in the value of bond holdings as yields shift.
segments.tr: - **सेवानिवृत्ति पोर्टफोलियो** यील्ड में बदलाव के रूप में बॉन्ड होल्डिंग्स के मूल्य में बदलाव देख सकते हैं।

segments.src: - **Public services** may face tighter funding if more tax revenue goes to interest.
segments.tr: - **सार्वजनिक सेवाएं** तंग फंडिंग का सामना कर सकती हैं यदि अधिक कर राजस्व ब्याज में जाता है।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.src: A 10-year yield around 5.3% is a reminder that debt is not free.
segments.tr: लगभग 5.3% की 10-वर्षीय यील्ड एक याद दिलाती है कि ऋण मुफ्त नहीं है।

segments.src: The cost of borrowing is set by markets, and it flows directly into the federal budget as interest payments.
segments.tr: उधार लेने की लागत बाजारों द्वारा निर्धारित की जाती है, और यह ब्याज भुगतान के रूप में सीधे संघीय बजट में प्रवाहित होती है।

segments.src: Because those payments are owed before discretionary choices are made, they shape what is left for defense, Social Security support, public investment and everything else.
segments.tr: चूंकि वे भुगतान विवेकाधीन विकल्प बनाने से पहले देय हैं, इसलिए वे रक्षा, सोशल सिक्योरिटी सहायता, सार्वजनिक निवेश और बाकी सब कुछ के लिए जो बचा है उसे आकार देते हैं।

segments.src: How Washington responds, through spending, revenue and growth policy, will determine how heavy that bill becomes.

es.title: La factura de intereses se vence: qué significa un rendimiento del Tesoro a 10 años del 5.3% para el presupuesto de Washington

segments.src: When the benchmark 10-year Treasury yield climbed to about 5.3%, it reached a level not seen in more than two decades.
segments.tr: Cuando el rendimiento de referencia del Tesoro a 10 años subió a alrededor del 5.3%, alcanzó un nivel no visto en más de dos décadas.

segments.src: For most people, a bond yield is an abstract number on a financial news ticker.
segments.tr: Para la mayoría de las personas, el rendimiento de un bono es un número abstracto en un teletipo de noticias financieras.

segments.src: For the federal government, it is something closer to an interest rate on a very large credit line, and it determines how much taxpayers must pay each year just to carry the national debt.
segments.tr: Para el gobierno federal, es algo más parecido a una tasa de interés en una línea de crédito muy grande, y determina cuánto deben pagar los contribuyentes cada año solo para cargar con la deuda nacional.

segments.src: This explainer walks through how Treasury yields translate into federal interest costs, why those costs matter, and how they compete with other priorities in the federal budget.
segments.tr: Este artículo explicativo detalla cómo los rendimientos del Tesoro se traducen en costos de intereses federales, por qué importan esos costos y cómo compiten con otras prioridades en el presupuesto federal.

segments.src: Figures below are rounded and illustrative; check the Treasury Department, the Congressional Budget Office (CBO) and the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) for the latest official numbers.
segments.tr: Las cifras a continuación están redondeadas y son ilustrativas; consulte al Departamento del Tesoro, a la Oficina de Presupuesto del Congreso (CBO) y a la Oficina de Administración y Presupuesto (OMB) para obtener las últimas cifras oficiales.

segments.src: ## Why the 10-year yield matters
segments.tr: ## Por qué importa el rendimiento a 10 años

segments.src: The 10-year Treasury note is one of the most closely watched interest rates in the world.
segments.tr: El bono del Tesoro a 10 años es una de las tasas de interés más vigiladas del mundo.

segments.src: It reflects what investors demand to lend money to the U.S.
segments.tr: Refleja lo que los inversores exigen para prestar dinero a EE. UU.

segments.src: government for a decade.
segments.tr: gobierno durante una década.

segments.src: It also acts as a reference point for many other borrowing costs, including mortgage rates, corporate bonds and some business loans.
segments.tr: También actúa como punto de referencia para muchos otros costos de endeudamiento, incluidas las tasas hipotecarias, los bonos corporativos y algunos préstamos comerciales.

segments.src: A rising yield means the government must offer investors a higher return to attract buyers at auction.
segments.tr: Un rendimiento en aumento significa que el gobierno debe ofrecer a los inversores un mayor rendimiento para atraer compradores en las subastas.

segments.src: Yields move for several reasons:
segments.tr: Los rendimientos se mueven por varias razones:

segments.src: - **Expectations for inflation:** If investors expect prices to keep rising, they ask for a higher yield to protect purchasing power.
segments.tr: - **Expectativas de inflación:** Si los inversores esperan que los precios sigan subiendo, piden un mayor rendimiento para proteger su poder adquisitivo.

segments.src: - **Central bank policy:** The Federal Reserve sets short-term rates directly and influences longer-term rates through its policy path and balance sheet.
segments.tr: - **Política del banco central:** La Reserva Federal fija las tasas a corto plazo directamente e influye en las tasas a más largo plazo a través de su trayectoria política y su hoja de balance.

segments.src: - **Supply and demand:** Heavy federal borrowing increases the supply of Treasuries, which can push yields higher if demand does not keep pace.
segments.tr: - **Oferta y demanda:** Un fuerte endeudamiento federal aumenta la oferta de títulos del Tesoro, lo que puede empujar los rendimientos al alza si la demanda no sigue el mismo ritmo.

segments.src: - **Perceived risk and term premium:** Investors may require extra compensation for the uncertainty of lending over a long period.
segments.tr: - **Riesgo percibido y prima por plazo:** Los inversores pueden requerir una compensación adicional por la incertidumbre de prestar durante un largo período.

segments.src: ## From yield to interest bill
segments.tr: ## Del rendimiento a la factura de intereses

segments.src: The federal government does not borrow all at once at a single rate.
segments.tr: El gobierno federal no se endeuda todo de una vez a una sola tasa.

segments.src: It issues a mix of short-term bills, medium-term notes and long-term bonds.
segments.tr: Emite una combinación de letras a corto plazo, notas a mediano plazo y bonos a largo plazo.

segments.src: Existing debt keeps paying the rate set when it was issued until it matures.
segments.tr: La deuda existente sigue pagando la tasa establecida cuando se emitió hasta su vencimiento.

segments.src: Then the Treasury refinances it at whatever rates prevail at that time.
segments.tr: Luego, el Tesoro la refinancia a las tasas que prevalezcan en ese momento.

segments.src: This is why the cost of higher rates arrives gradually:
segments.tr: Esta es la razón por la cual el costo de las tasas más altas llega gradualmente:

segments.src: 1. **New borrowing** to cover current deficits is priced at today's yields.
segments.tr: 1. **Nuevo endeudamiento** para cubrir los déficits actuales se valora a los rendimientos de hoy.

segments.src: 2. **Maturing debt** that was issued when rates were very low must be rolled over at higher rates.
segments.tr: 2. **Deuda que vence** y que se emitió cuando las tasas eran muy bajas debe renovarse a tasas más altas.

segments.src: 3. **Short-term bills** reprice quickly, so they pass higher rates into the budget almost immediately.
segments.tr: 3. **Letras a corto plazo** reajustan su precio rápidamente, por lo que trasladan las tasas más altas al presupuesto casi de inmediato.

segments.src: The result is that the *average* interest rate on all federal debt tends to lag behind market yields, then drift upward as older, cheaper debt is replaced.
segments.tr: El resultado es que la tasa de interés *promedio* de toda la deuda federal tiende a retrasarse con respecto a los rendimientos del mercado, y luego asciende a medida que la deuda más antigua y barata es reemplazada.

segments.src: Even if yields stopped rising today, the average cost of the debt could keep climbing for years.
segments.tr: Incluso si los rendimientos dejaran de subir hoy, el costo promedio de la deuda podría seguir subiendo durante años.

segments.src: ## A simple way to see the scale
segments.tr: ## Una forma sencilla de ver la escala

segments.src: Total federal debt held by the public is measured in tens of trillions of dollars.
segments.tr: La deuda federal total en manos del público se mide en decenas de billones de dólares.

segments.src: A small change in the average interest rate, applied to a base that large, adds up quickly.
segments.tr: Un pequeño cambio en la tasa de interés promedio, aplicado a una base tan grande, se acumula rápidamente.

segments.src: As a rough rule of thumb, each additional percentage point on the average rate adds hundreds of billions of dollars in annual interest costs once it has fully worked through the debt portfolio.
segments.tr: Como regla general aproximada, cada punto porcentual adicional en la tasa promedio añade cientos de miles de millones de dólares en costos de intereses anuales una vez que se ha integrado por completo en la cartera de deuda.

segments.src: In recent years, net interest has grown into one of the largest single items in the federal budget.
segments.tr: En los últimos años, los intereses netos se han convertido en uno de los elementos individuales más grandes del presupuesto federal.

segments.src: CBO projections have shown it surpassing major categories of spending that policymakers have long treated as fixed priorities.
segments.tr: Las proyecciones de la CBO han mostrado que superan importantes categorías de gasto que los legisladores han tratado durante mucho tiempo como prioridades fijas.

segments.src: Net interest is also growing faster than most other parts of the budget, because it depends on both the size of the debt and the level of interest rates, and both have moved up.
segments.tr: Los intereses netos también están creciendo más rápido que la mayoría de las otras partes del presupuesto, porque dependen tanto del tamaño de la deuda como del nivel de las tasas de interés, y ambos han aumentado.

segments.src: ## How interest competes with other spending
segments.tr: ## Cómo compiten los intereses con otros gastos

segments.src: Interest is different from most budget items.
segments.tr: Los intereses son diferentes a la mayoría de las partidas presupuestarias.

segments.src: It is not a program that Congress can fund at a chosen level each year.
segments.tr: No son un programa que el Congreso pueda financiar a un nivel elegido cada año.

segments.src: It is a legal obligation tied to Treasury securities that investors already hold.
segments.tr: Es una obligación legal vinculada a los valores del Tesoro que los inversores ya poseen.

segments.src: That makes it a kind of first claim on federal revenue.
segments.tr: Eso lo convierte en una especie de primera reclamación sobre los ingresos federales.

segments.src: The federal budget generally falls into three broad groups:
segments.tr: El presupuesto federal generalmente se divide en tres grandes grupos:

segments.src: - **Mandatory spending**, such as Social Security and Medicare, which is set by existing law and eligibility rules.
segments.tr: - **Gasto obligatorio**, como el Seguro Social y Medicare, que está determinado por la ley vigente y las reglas de elegibilidad.

segments.src: - **Discretionary spending**, including defense, education, transportation, scientific research and many other programs that Congress funds through annual appropriations.
segments.tr: - **Gasto discrecional**, que incluye defensa, educación, transporte, investigación científica y muchos otros programas que el Congreso financia mediante asignaciones anuales.

segments.src: - **Net interest**, which is determined by the debt and prevailing interest rates.
segments.tr: - **Intereses netos**, que están determinados por la deuda y las tasas de interés vigentes.

segments.src: When net interest rises, it does not simply sit beside the other categories.
segments.tr: Cuando los intereses netos aumentan, no se limitan a colocarse junto a las otras categorías.

segments.src: Every dollar spent on interest is a dollar not available for other purposes unless revenue increases or borrowing grows further.
segments.tr: Cada dólar gastado en intereses es un dólar que no está disponible para otros fines a menos que aumenten los ingresos o crezca aún más el endeudamiento.

segments.src: That creates several pressures:
segments.tr: Eso crea varias presiones:

segments.src: - **Defense:** Defense is the largest part of discretionary spending. Net interest costs that approach or exceed the defense budget can sharpen debates over military readiness, modernization and force size.
segments.tr: - **Defensa:** La defensa es la parte más grande del gasto discrecional. Los costos de intereses netos que se acerquen o superen el presupuesto de defensa pueden agudizar los debates sobre la preparación militar, la modernización y el tamaño de las fuerzas.

segments.src: - **Social Security and health programs:** These programs are already expected to grow as the population ages. Higher interest costs add to the total pressure on the budget at the same time.
segments.tr: - **Seguro Social y programas de salud:** Ya se espera que estos programas crezcan a medida que la población envejece. Mayores costos de intereses se suman a la presión total sobre el presupuesto al mismo tiempo.

segments.src: - **Other discretionary programs:** Areas such as infrastructure, research, education and public safety make up a smaller share of the budget and can feel the squeeze most when overall resources are tight.
segments.tr: - **Otros programas discrecionales:** Áreas como infraestructura, investigación, educación y seguridad pública representan una porción menor del presupuesto y pueden sentir más la presión cuando los recursos generales son escasos.

segments.src: - **Borrowing itself:** If the government borrows more to pay interest, the debt grows, which can lead to more interest in the following years. Analysts sometimes describe this as a compounding effect.
segments.tr: - **El endeudamiento en sí:** Si el gobierno se endeuda más para pagar intereses, la deuda crece, lo que puede conducir a más intereses en los años siguientes. Los analistas a veces describen esto como un efecto compuesto.

segments.src: ## What could change the picture
segments.tr: ## Qué podría cambiar el panorama

segments.src: The outlook is not fixed.
segments.tr: Las perspectivas no son fijas.

segments.src: Several factors could raise or lower future interest costs:
segments.tr: Varios factores podrían aumentar o disminuir los futuros costos de intereses:

segments.src: - **Interest rate path:** If inflation cools and the Federal Reserve lowers rates, yields could fall and ease pressure. If inflation proves stubborn, yields could stay elevated.
segments.tr: - **Trayectoria de las tasas de interés:** Si la inflación se enfría y la Reserva Federal baja las tasas, los rendimientos podrían caer y aliviar la presión. Si la inflación resulta persistente, los rendimientos podrían mantenerse elevados.

segments.src: - **Economic growth:** Stronger growth increases tax revenue and can make a given level of debt easier to manage relative to the size of the economy.
segments.tr: - **Crecimiento económico:** Un crecimiento más fuerte aumenta los ingresos fiscales y puede hacer que un nivel determinado de deuda sea más fácil de manejar en relación con el tamaño de la economía.

segments.src: - **Deficit decisions:** Changes in tax and spending policy affect how much new debt must be issued.
segments.tr: - **Decisiones sobre el déficit:** Los cambios en la política fiscal y de gasto afectan cuánta deuda nueva se debe emitir.

segments.src: - **Debt maturity choices:** The Treasury can adjust the mix of short- and long-term securities, which changes how quickly rate moves hit the budget.
segments.tr: - **Opciones de vencimiento de la deuda:** El Tesoro puede ajustar la combinación de valores a corto y largo plazo, lo que cambia la rapidez con la que los movimientos de tasas golpean al presupuesto.

segments.src: - **Investor demand:** Appetite for Treasuries from domestic and foreign buyers affects the yields the government must pay.
segments.tr: - **Demanda de los inversores:** El apetito por los títulos del Tesoro por parte de compradores nacionales y extranjeros afecta los rendimientos que el gobierno debe pagar.

segments.src: Economists and budget analysts disagree about how serious the risk is and what to do about it.
segments.tr: Los economistas y analistas presupuestarios no están de acuerdo sobre cuán serio es el riesgo y qué hacer al respecto.

segments.src: Some stress the importance of gradual deficit reduction to stabilize debt.
segments.tr: Algunos destacan la importancia de una reducción gradual del déficit para estabilizar la deuda.

segments.src: Others point out that growth, productivity and lower inflation can also improve the ratio of debt to the economy.
segments.tr: Otros señalan que el crecimiento, la productividad y una menor inflación también pueden mejorar la proporción de la deuda con respecto a la economía.

segments.src: Reasonable people weigh these tradeoffs differently, and the choices ultimately belong to voters and elected officials.
segments.tr: Las personas razonables sopesan estas compensaciones de manera diferente, y las elecciones corresponden en última instancia a los votantes y a los funcionarios electos.

segments.src: ## What it means for households
segments.tr: ## Lo que significa para los hogares

segments.src: A federal budget issue can feel distant, but higher Treasury yields reach households in practical ways:
segments.tr: Un problema presupuestario federal puede parecer lejano, pero los rendimientos más altos del Tesoro llegan a los hogares de maneras prácticas:

segments.src: - **Mortgage and loan rates** often move with long-term Treasury yields, affecting the cost of buying a home or financing a car.
segments.tr: - **Las tasas hipotecarias y de préstamos** a menudo se mueven con los rendimientos del Tesoro a largo plazo, afectando el costo de comprar una casa o financiar un automóvil.

segments.src: - **Savings and money market accounts** may offer better returns when rates are higher.
segments.tr: - **Las cuentas de ahorros y del mercado monetario** pueden ofrecer mejores rendimientos cuando las tasas son más altas.

segments.src: - **Retirement portfolios** can see changes in the value of bond holdings as yields shift.
segments.tr: - **Las carteras de jubilación** pueden ver cambios en el valor de las tenencias de bonos a medida que cambian los rendimientos.

segments.src: - **Public services** may face tighter funding if more tax revenue goes to interest.
segments.tr: - **Los servicios públicos** pueden enfrentar una financiación más ajustada si se destinan más ingresos fiscales a los intereses.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: A 10-year yield around 5.3% is a reminder that debt is not free.
segments.tr: Un rendimiento a 10 años de alrededor del 5.3% es un recordatorio de que la deuda no es gratuita.

segments.src: The cost of borrowing is set by markets, and it flows directly into the federal budget as interest payments.
segments.tr: El costo del endeudamiento lo fijan los mercados y fluye directamente al presupuesto federal como pagos de intereses.

segments.src: Because those payments are owed before discretionary choices are made, they shape what is left for defense, Social Security support, public investment and everything else.
segments.tr: Debido a que esos pagos se deben antes de tomar decisiones discrecionales, moldean lo que queda para la defensa, el apoyo al Seguro Social, la inversión pública y todo lo demás.

segments.src: How Washington responds, through spending, revenue and growth policy, will determine how heavy that bill becomes.
segments.tr: Cómo responda Washington, a través de la política de gasto, ingresos y crecimiento, determinará cuán pesada se vuelve esa factura.
